title: Early Peanut Eating Cut Allergy Rates From 13.7% To 1.9%
hook: Avoiding peanuts produced 13.7% allergies; early eating produced 1.9%.
closing: The old avoidance advice protected children from the wrong thing.
question: Did your family get the old advice?

segments.say: Peanut allergy prevalence climbed from 0.4% in 1997 to 1.4% in 2008.
Peanut allergy reached 13.7% with avoidance versus 1.9% with early eating.
Diagnoses fell from 0.79% to 0.45%, about 43%, after guidance changed.
